articles.title: Cardano Foundation spins out Veridian, tokenizes its shares on new standard
articles.snippet: Veridian became the first company to use Cardano’s new programmable-token standard for its equity, though the tokenized shares are not being offered to the public.

articles.title: Over 6 million bitcoin sit behind exposed public keys as AI warnings mount
articles.snippet: Glassnode co-founder's latest figures show growing public-key exposure as Justin Drake urges preparations for potential AI attacks on wallet cryptography.

articles.title: Standard Chartered to expand institutional crypto and RWA custody to Singapore
articles.snippet: The bank would offer the service to institutions and accredited corporate investors, subject to regulatory requirements.

articles.title: Greece prepares to levy 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrency
articles.snippet: Crypto gains of up to 500 euros ($560) a year would be exempt under the bill, which will be submitted to parliament in November.

articles.title: Crypto’s heavy backing of Republicans alienated Democrats: Cuomo
articles.snippet: Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo urged the crypto industry to balance its support for Democrats and Republicans if they want federal crypto legislation passed.
